name: DeltaPrime unvalidated LFJ reward pair
summary: TraderJoeV2ArbitrumFacet.claimReward() accepted an arbitrary LFJ pair without checking that the factory created it, then trusted that pair's hook and rewarder. The malicious rewarder called back into the Prime Account to wrap its borrowed native ETH between the function's before/after WETH balance checks, causing collateral and debt proceeds to be misclassified and paid out as rewards without a solvency check.

loss.notes: Arbitrum leg only. Components are the exact depletion of DeltaPrime's five Arbitrum lending pools across the thirteen defect-executing campaign transactions and the loot sweep, summed from their ERC-20 Transfer logs: WethPool 0x2e2fe9bc7904649b65b6373baf40f9e2e0b883c5 -66.619545304650988218 WETH (all of it in the anchor transaction), UsdcPool 0x5f3db5899a7937c9abf0a5fc91718e6f813e4195 -271614.819122 USDC, BtcPool 0x275caecf5542bf4a3cf64aa78a3f57dc9939675c -2.96703344 WBTC, ArbPool 0x14c82cfc2c651700a66abdd7dc375c9ceefddd72 -50060.231512018705280417 ARB and DaiPool 0x7dcf909b1e4b280bee72c6a69b3a7ed8adfb63f0 -2769.105063733408190911 DAI. Every unit is accounted for in attacker hands: the sweep 0xac2132626ed42a611cbca336fca7a6cdafabe919ca95f39f80dcb9a2e24103b7 moved 33.209772652325494104 WETH, 271614.819122 USDC, 2.96703344 WBTC, 35749.434643912413610260 ARB and 2769.105063733408190911 DAI to loot address 0x56e7f67211683857ee31a1220827cac5cdaa634c, the attacker-deployed fake LFJ pair 0x52ee5c0ea2e7b38d4b24c09d4d18cba6c293200e kept the 14310.796868106291670157 ARB drained after that sweep, and the rest of the pool WETH left that contract as native ETH: 0.2 unwrapped inside the sweep, 33.200000000000004096 unwrapped in 0xdf0a5c1ae3fd412d565802b2ae542a1d6e4a585a00648181785b1282175a4a64 at block 273283967 and a final 0.009000000000008 at block 273345812, leaving about 0.00077 WETH of dust. The pool WETH is counted once: the attacker recycled the same 66.619545304650988218 WETH out of the fake pair as working capital for each later transaction and returned it every time. Balancer flash loans through vault 0xba12222222228d8ba445958a75a0704d566bf2c8 are repaid inside their transactions and are not loss; no attacker-supplied capital was consumed. The Avalanche leg of the same campaign is carried by its own record eip155:43114:0xece4efbe11e59d457cb1359ebdc4efdffdd310f0a82440be03591f2e27d2b59e and is deliberately not included here. DeltaPrime's rounded 4.75 million USD post-mortem figure and Verichains' analysis cover both chains together and must not be added to a per-chain measurement; CertiK splits the campaign as about 753 thousand USD on Arbitrum and about 4.1 million USD on Avalanche, which matches the two records. DeltaPrime separately lost about 5.98 million USD to a September 16 private-key compromise; that is a different incident. DAI uses stablecoin par because DefiLlama has no observation at or before the campaign end for it.

lastCodeChange.description: DiamondCut on SmartLoanDiamondBeacon 0x62cf82fb0484af382714cd09296260edc1dc0c6c replaced the route for selector 0xb2af870a (claimReward(address,uint256[])) with TraderJoeV2ArbitrumFacet 0xd6002c3f5a53107cb11cc0b8de5f76f61f18cb5d, the defect-bearing artifact, alongside 0x2001ff29 and 0x08a766eb. This is the last of six pre-exploit cuts touching that selector out of 150 DiamondCut events on the beacon, and beacon.implementation(0xb2af870a) still returns that facet at block 273278741. The beacon is shared by every DeltaPrime Prime Account, so the defect was live for all of them from this cut onward; the attacker's own Prime Account 0xf81b4381b70ef520ae635afd4b0e8aeb994131fb was merely instantiated against the already-defective route eight seconds before the exploit and does not reset the artifact age.

sources.note: Re-review that re-anchors the code age to the shared facet activation and replaces the previously reported cross-chain loss with an Arbitrum-only onchain reconstruction; it supersedes an earlier OpenAI Codex note that used the per-user Prime Account creation as the age basis and DeltaPrime’s rounded 4.75 million USD campaign figure as the loss. Anchor: 0x6a2f989b5493b52ffc078d0a59a3bf9727d134b403aa6e0bf309fd513a728f7f is status 1 at block 273278742 index 1, timestamp 1731310565, sent by 0xb87881637b5c8e6885c51ab7d895e53fa7d7c567 to orchestrator 0x0b2bcf06f740c322bc7276b6b90de08812ce9bfe; it is the first defect-executing success of the campaign. Its callTracer trace has exactly one DELEGATECALL from Prime Account 0xf81b4381b70ef520ae635afd4b0e8aeb994131fb to TraderJoeV2ArbitrumFacet 0xd6002c3f5a53107cb11cc0b8de5f76f61f18cb5d with selector 0xb2af870a, resolved through beacon.implementation on SmartLoanDiamondBeacon 0x62cf82fb0484af382714cd09296260edc1dc0c6c, and the malicious rewarder in the attacker-deployed fake LFJ pair 0x52ee5c0ea2e7b38d4b24c09d4d18cba6c293200e re-enters the account to wrap borrowed native ETH between the facet's before/after WETH balance snapshots. Code history: I pulled all 150 DiamondCut events (topic 0x8faa70878671ccd212d20771b795c50af8fd3ff6cf27f4bde57e5d4de0aeb673) emitted by the beacon up to the exploit block and decoded every FacetCut. Six touch selector 0xb2af870a; the last is log index 24 of 0xdf204ce6aac17e5a511cd0a169e55c8f2bb431e7b0f219eea2a7ef4285e26a24 at block 271974750 index 7, block timestamp 1730982558, a Replace whose facetAddress in data word 5 is 0xd6002c3f5a53107cb11cc0b8de5f76f61f18cb5d and whose selector list is 0x2001ff29, 0x08a766eb, 0xb2af870a. No later cut re-routes the selector, and beacon.implementation(0xb2af870a) returns 0xd6002c3f5a53107cb11cc0b8de5f76f61f18cb5d at block 273278741. The facet was created by top-level CREATE from 0x5ee7673ba06a87f125d14f2c009ec2c4de02728c in 0xdfa19ad88a203fc454bf3bb8fad9d9451bfa05d28ccebf5238df7b9ec3c7f80d at block 270940742 index 3, with no code at 270940741, and its runtime hashes to 0x24783f83b2a34799fc181a436d356d3ed6e76782fc6444bd3f327bc7fe681a75 at blocks 270940742, 271974749, 271974750 and 273278741, so it is byte-identical from deployment through the exploit. codeAgeSeconds is therefore 1731310565 - 1730982558 = 328007 seconds (3.80 days), measured on the shared beacon-routed facet rather than on the attacker-instantiated Prime Account. The execution context remains Prime Account 0xf81b4381b70ef520ae635afd4b0e8aeb994131fb, internally created by DeltaPrime factory 0xff5e3ddaeff411a1dc6cce00014e4bca39265c20 in 0x4183bec6ed03429f1582850d2e04d6d8b3898ddca971f1665190c62ede981ecd at block 273278712 index 1, timestamp 1731310557, and that creation is the deployment anchor. Loss: I enumerated every transaction of 0xb87881637b5c8e6885c51ab7d895e53fa7d7c567 on Arbitrum (33 in total; the rest are attacker-contract creations) and netted the ERC-20 Transfer logs of the fourteen value-moving ones (thirteen defect-executing drains plus the loot sweep). Exactly five addresses lose value, all DeltaPrime pools identified by their tokenAddress() and by borrow() calls in the trace: WethPool 0x2e2fe9bc7904649b65b6373baf40f9e2e0b883c5 -66.619545304650988218 WETH, UsdcPool 0x5f3db5899a7937c9abf0a5fc91718e6f813e4195 -271614.819122 USDC, BtcPool 0x275caecf5542bf4a3cf64aa78a3f57dc9939675c -2.96703344 WBTC, ArbPool 0x14c82cfc2c651700a66abdd7dc375c9ceefddd72 -50060.231512018705280417 ARB, DaiPool 0x7dcf909b1e4b280bee72c6a69b3a7ed8adfb63f0 -2769.105063733408190911 DAI. The destination side closes exactly: the sweep 0xac2132626ed42a611cbca336fca7a6cdafabe919ca95f39f80dcb9a2e24103b7 credits loot EOA 0x56e7f67211683857ee31a1220827cac5cdaa634c with 33.209772652325494104 WETH, 271614.819122 USDC, 2.96703344 WBTC, 35749.434643912413610260 ARB and 2769.105063733408190911 DAI; the fake pair keeps the two post-sweep ARB drains totalling 14310.796868106291670157 ARB (its balance at block 273290000 confirms this) and unwraps the remaining pool WETH to native ETH in burns of 0.2 (inside the sweep), 33.200000000000004096 (0xdf0a5c1ae3fd412d565802b2ae542a1d6e4a585a00648181785b1282175a4a64, block 273283967) and 0.009000000000008 (block 273345812), leaving about 0.00077 WETH of dust. DefiLlama historical prices at 1731310565 on arbitrum give WETH 3135.69, USDC 0.999939, WBTC 80853, ARB 0.619017 and DAI 0.99946, totalling 754145.79 USD, which matches CertiK’s roughly 753 thousand USD Arbitrum figure. The DAI quote is DefiLlama’s nearest observation at 1731311939, about 23 minutes after the anchor and inside the campaign window; the other four are within ten seconds of the anchor. This record is Arbitrum-only and is disjoint from the Avalanche record eip155:43114:0xece4efbe11e59d457cb1359ebdc4efdffdd310f0a82440be03591f2e27d2b59e.
